races.verdict: MUSICAL ANGEL won this race from a similar mark last year and a recent second over C&D served warning that she's ready to strike again. Velvet Rhythm shaped really well last time and is very much respected but her blowout on sole start at this track is a concern, while Silver Trumpet could go well if starting better than last time.
